site.name: House of Stone
site.description: A contemporary art house for Zimbabwean stone sculpture. Discover the artists, explore the collection, and enquire about a work.
site.heroAlt: Stone sculpture in an architectural black gallery, illuminated by warm overhead light

artists.name: Tariro Mavhunga
artists.description: A sculptural practice exploring the relationship between quiet gestures and architectural space.
artists.story: Pale stone is shaped into soft folds. The work moves between the weight of the material and the suggestion of something lighter.

artists.name: Kudakwashe Nyamudeza
artists.description: A sculptural practice centered on open forms, polished edges and the space they hold.
artists.story: The hollow is treated as carefully as the stone around it. Broad grounded forms taper toward a fine edge, balancing mass and movement.

artists.name: Ruvimbo Chikore
artists.description: A practice exploring the relationship between paired figures, touch and shared space.
artists.story: Distinct curves lean toward each other. The stone remains tactile and expressive, with polished surfaces meeting natural texture.

artists.name: Farai Munetsi
artists.description: A sculptural practice translating the movement of birds into restrained, abstract form.
artists.story: Line and balance guide the form. A long curve and a small shift of weight suggest motion without describing every detail.

artists.name: Tendai Nyakudya
artists.description: A practice exploring stacked forms, opposing surfaces and architectural rhythm.
artists.story: Simple masses are arranged with precision. A polished face meets a rougher edge, and each proportion changes the balance of the whole.

works.title: Folded Light
works.description: An abstract ribbon, its folded planes opening to the light.

works.title: Continuum
works.description: A flowing open form. A dark surface revealed through warm illumination.

works.title: Together
works.description: Two connected forms, held in a single gesture of green stone.

works.title: Quiet Flight
works.description: An abstract bird in warm amber stone, poised between rest and movement.

works.title: Equilibrium
works.description: A grounded architectural form, balancing stacked planes and contrasting textures.
